run_train_loop: run a PyTorch training loop with model, loss, optimizer, and TensorBoard logging
load_checkpoint: load a PyTorch model checkpoint from a file or directory with optional parameter filtering
save_checkpoint: save a PyTorch model and optimizer state dict to a checkpoint file
process_losses: preprocess a dictionary of loss tensors by detaching and reducing to scalar values
load_config: load an OmegaConf config file from a YAML path and resolve the run directory
